First Watch Menu: Top 10 Items You’ll Love for Brunch

At First Watch, brunch isn’t just about food—it’s an experience. The diverse and specialty-driven menu features a variety of dishes that cater to different tastes and dietary preferences, from gluten-free and vegetarian options to more indulgent treats like the famous Million Dollar Bacon. Let’s take a closer look at the must-try brunch items that will keep you coming back for more.

1. Avocado Toast with a Twist

First Watch’s Avocado Toast is an elevated take on the classic. This dish includes freshly smashed avocado, lemon-dressed arugula, and a sprinkle of Maldon sea salt on whole grain artisan toast with all-natural house preserves. It’s the perfect way to start your day with healthy fats and fresh ingredients.

Price: $10.99

Nutritional Information Details
Calories 680
Total Fat 45g (Healthy fats from avocado)
Fiber 12g
Protein 15g (Includes protein from egg)
Ingredients Avocado, Arugula, Sea Salt, Egg

2. Million Dollar Bacon

One of the most indulgent items on the menu is the Million Dollar Bacon, baked with brown sugar, Maldon sea salt, and a drizzle of maple syrup. If you’re looking for something to kickstart your brunch with a bang, this sweet-and-salty treat is an absolute must.

Price: $5.49

Nutritional Information Details
Calories 320
Total Fat 24g
Carbohydrates 16g (Includes sugar from syrup)
Protein 7g
Ingredients Bacon, Brown Sugar, Sea Salt, Syrup

3. Power Bowls

For those looking to pack a nutritious punch, First Watch’s Power Bowls are loaded with nutrient-dense ingredients. The most popular option is the Quinoa Power Bowl, which includes organic mixed greens, fresh smashed avocado, house-roasted onions, and a perfectly cooked over-easy cage-free egg.

Price: $9.99

Nutritional Information Details
Calories 520
Total Fat 28g (Healthy fats from avocado & egg)
Fiber 10g
Protein 20g (From egg and quinoa)
Ingredients Quinoa, Avocado, Onions, Mixed Greens, Egg

4. The Chickichanga

This fan-favorite is a sun-dried tomato-basil tortilla stuffed with all-natural chicken, housemade pico de gallo, cheddar and Monterey Jack cheese, and seasoned black beans. It’s topped with freshly baked tortilla strips, house-roasted onions, and served with a side of lemon-dressed organic mixed greens.

Price: $11.79

Nutritional Information Details
Calories 870
Total Fat 48g
Protein 35g (High protein from chicken)
Carbohydrates 80g
Ingredients Chicken, Tortilla, Cheese, Black Beans, Pico de Gallo

5. Lemon Ricotta Pancakes

These light and fluffy pancakes are made with housemade lemon ricotta, topped with mixed berry compote, and drizzled with maple syrup. The perfect blend of sweet and citrusy flavors makes this a popular choice for pancake lovers.

Price: $9.99

Nutritional Information Details
Calories 740
Total Fat 35g
Carbohydrates 85g (Sugars from syrup and compote)
Protein 16g (Includes protein from ricotta)
Ingredients Pancakes, Ricotta, Mixed Berries, Syrup

6. Egg White Omelet

If you prefer a lighter breakfast, the egg white omelet at First Watch is a delicious choice. It’s packed with fresh veggies, such as house-roasted onions, arugula, and herbed goat cheese. Served with a side of whole grain artisan toast and a freshly baked muffin, this dish provides a nutrient-rich start to your day.

Price: $10.49

Nutritional Information Details
Calories 420
Total Fat 18g (Healthy fats from goat cheese)
Protein 28g (High protein from egg whites)
Carbohydrates 35g (From toast and muffin)
Ingredients Egg Whites, Onions, Arugula, Goat Cheese, Toast, Muffin

7. Seasonal Specials

First Watch’s Seasonal Menu changes throughout the year, incorporating fresh and locally sourced ingredients. From gingerbread pancakes in the winter to watermelon wake-up juice in the summer, these limited-time dishes offer something new every time you visit.

Seasonal Specials:

Dish Price
Gingerbread Pancakes $10.49
Maple Syrup Drizzle French Toast $9.99
Fresh Fruit Smoothie $5.99

8. Fresh Fruit & Housemade Granola

For a refreshing and lighter option, consider the fresh fruit and housemade granola. This simple yet tasty dish features housemade granola with almonds, freshly baked muffins, and a side of lemon-dressed organic mixed greens.

Price: $8.99

Nutritional Information Details
Calories 450
Total Fat 20g (Healthy fats from almonds and granola)
Carbohydrates 60g (Natural sugars from fruit)
Protein 12g
Ingredients Granola, Almonds, Fresh Fruit, Muffin, Mixed Greens

9. Classic Favorites: The Traditional Breakfast

The Traditional Breakfast at First Watch is a staple that includes two cage-free eggs any style, a choice of bacon, pork sausage, or chicken sausage patties, and a side of seasoned potatoes or fresh fruit. Served with whole grain artisan toast, this is a hearty, balanced option for any brunch-goer.

Price: $11.99

Nutritional Information Details
Calories 710
Total Fat 45g (Varies with choice of meat)
Protein 25g (High protein from eggs and sausage)
Carbohydrates 55g (From potatoes or fruit, and toast)
Ingredients Eggs, Bacon/Sausage, Potatoes/Fruit, Toast

10. French Toast with a Twist

First Watch’s French Toast is made using whole grain artisan toast dipped in a rich batter, then topped with powdered cinnamon sugar and housemade preserves. It’s a sweet and comforting way to end (or start) your brunch.

Price: $9.49

Nutritional Information Details
Calories 600
Total Fat 20g
Carbohydrates 85g (High-carb from toast and preserves)
Protein 12g
Ingredients Whole Grain Toast, Batter, Cinnamon Sugar, Preserves

First Watch Seasonal Menu

First Watch continues to innovate its menu with seasonal specials that reflect the freshest ingredients of each season. From spring’s fresh fruit-forward dishes to fall’s comforting pumpkin-infused creations, the seasonal menu is always worth exploring. Keep an eye out for items like:

  • Spring Strawberry Toast: A refreshing take on avocado toast with fresh strawberries and housemade preserves.
  • Fall Pumpkin Pancakes: Rich and spiced, topped with gingerbread cookie crumbles.

Menu Pricing Overview

Here’s a quick look at some of the price ranges you can expect when visiting First Watch:

Menu Item Price

Million Dollar Bacon $5.49
Power Bowls $9.99
Chickichanga $11.79
Lemon Ricotta Pancakes $9.99
Egg White Omelet $10.49
Traditional Breakfast $11.99
French Toast $9.49
Seasonal Specials $9.99 – $12.99

Conclusion

Whether you’re a brunch aficionado or someone who simply enjoys a delicious and nutritious start to your day, First Watch’s menu has something for everyone. From indulgent dishes like the Million Dollar Bacon to healthy favorites like the Egg White Omelet, First Watch remains one of the top brunch spots to visit. Don’t forget to explore their seasonal menu for new and exciting dishes that change throughout the year!
